chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Isma‘il ibn ‘Ammar, from Abu ‘Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
When the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله was seen in the dark night, a light was seen for him, as though it were a portion of the moon.

key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, referring to Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.شِقَّةُ قَمَرٍ: a portion or piece of the moon, expressing the likeness of the light

ai.seo_question: What does al-Kafi narrate about the light of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله in the darkness of night?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a luminous sign associated with the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله in the darkness of night. It presents a report of his radiant presence, portraying a visible light around him like a piece of the moon.
